slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize total profit from the toys produced?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the optimization objective is to maximize total profit, fully covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent only asked a vague catch-all question about any other constraints, without targeting the relationship between boat and train quantities. The boat/train constraint was volunteered by the user simulator, and user-provided facts do not count as a hidden-slot hit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot, the objective, was explicitly asked and confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL. The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent recovered the P0 objective slot by directly asking whether to maximize total profit, but did not independently surface the P2 boat-versus-train constraint, which was instead volunteered by the user simulator. Overall the interaction was sufficient for a well-posed core model, with only a minor P2 omission.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
